verdict.rationale: Mercury offers invoicing: manual and automatic invoices [mercury-docs-4], an Accounts Receivable API with invoice CRUD and webhooks [mercury-docs-13], and payment-status tracking [mercury-docs-45]. However, nothing in the evidence describes overdue-invoice reminders, dunning, or automated follow-up. 'Automatic invoices' refers to sending invoices, not chasing unpaid ones, so the follow-up capability itself is unevidenced.
